nodes.label: Handoff: Phase 2 Glassmorphic Dark UI Overhaul
LecturePack Project History, Architecture and Roadmap
Phase 2 Plan: Premium Glassmorphic Dark UI
Project History and Core Architecture Decisions
Three-Stage Slide Detection Cascade
nodes.rationale: dHash fast screen (reject near-dups, accept obvious change), SSIM confirmation, then histogram+ pixel-diff tiebreaker, so cheap tests reject obvious duplicates before escalating to structural similarity metrics.

nodes.label: Stability Detection
nodes.rationale: After ACCEPT, waits for content to stabilize (N consecutive SSIM >= 0.97 probes at 0.25s) so the captured frame represents a settled slide state rather than a mid-transition frame.

nodes.label: Deterministic Slide Detection Pipeline
nodes.rationale: CV pipeline (crop, ignore masks, 480px grayscale downscale, blur, temporal median) with a staged cascade that prioritizes reproducibility and privacy over GPU/LLM approaches; captures progressive builds, not just hard scene cuts.

nodes.label: Resumable Stage Architecture
nodes.rationale: Each pipeline stage can be independently resumed so completed work is cached and re-export never retriggers transcription or slide detection.

nodes.label: Deterministic CV Pipeline (decision)
nodes.rationale: Uses local deterministic CV (SSIM, difference hashing, connected-components contour analysis) rather than GPU-bound LLMs or cloud APIs to guarantee reproducibility and privacy.

nodes.label: Out-of-Process Isolation
nodes.rationale: ffmpeg and whisper-cli run via QProcess to protect UI responsiveness; internal processing runs in QThread workers.

nodes.label: Immutable Raw Transcript
nodes.rationale: raw.json stays immutable for auditability; user corrections live in edited.json so edits can be reverted per segment without losing the baseline Whisper output.

nodes.label: Quantitative Hysteresis in Slide Detection
nodes.rationale: Candidate counts alone are misleading; tuning must use ground-truth matching with hysteresis, cooldowns and clustering to coalesce rapid progressive reveals and transient motion noise into clean single-slide candidates.

nodes.label: Slide Detector Ground-Truth Evaluation Framework
nodes.rationale: Ground truth (meaningful states with acceptance windows + distractor windows) is derived from construction schedule or human labels, not detector output; evaluator reports TP/FP/FN, P/R/F1, and per-distractor hits against acceptance targets (recall>=0.95, precision>=0.85).

nodes.label: Detection Precision Guards (fade/caption rejection)
nodes.rationale: Fade rejection (future-SSIM persistence threshold 0.90) and caption/overlay band rejection (contours entirely within bottom 15%) were calibrated on measured physical signatures, not per-frame magic numbers, so they remove fade and caption false positives without touching real progressive builds.

nodes.label: Two-Pass Single-Decode Slide Detection
nodes.rationale: v1.1 runs one FFmpeg process decoding once sequentially (crop, downscale, grayscale) streaming raw analysis frames over a pipe, replacing thousands of random keyframe seeks with tens of seeks at final candidate timestamps.

nodes.label: Concurrent Transcription + Detection
nodes.rationale: After audio extraction the two heavy independent stages run concurrently so wall time trends toward the slower branch (~33% vs staged on CPU+CPU contention).

nodes.label: Optional Vulkan GPU Engine (whisper.cpp ggml)
nodes.rationale: CPU-only fallback is mandatory; Vulkan only used when binary present, Vulkan runtime exists, and a recorded benchmark showed Vulkan faster (never assumes GPU is faster).

nodes.label: Stage Cache Keys (fingerprint)
nodes.rationale: Each completed stage records a fingerprint over its actual inputs; re-running skips stages whose fingerprints match and re-runs stages whose inputs changed.

nodes.label: Context Repair (post-processing)
nodes.rationale: Every AI proposal is shown with word-level diff, explanation and confidence to accept/reject/edit; none is auto-accepted, so occasional extra proposals are harmless. Deterministic offline approved-name provider is always available as fallback.

nodes.label: Local Ollama Integration
nodes.rationale: Optional; requests go to http://localhost:11434 only; nothing bundled; generation runs in a background worker so any failure surfaces as a retryable inline message and can never crash the app.

nodes.label: qwen3:1.7b Recommended Model
nodes.rationale: Benchmarked on this machine: qwen3:1.7b matches the 9B model's repair recall (5/8) at a fraction of time and memory (21.9s vs 51.0s).

nodes.label: Smart Study (optional local AI)
nodes.rationale: Detects Ollama, offers Lightweight (qwen3:1.7b) and Balanced (qwen3:4b) presets with RAM-based recommendation, model download with progress/cancel, one structured test request, persistence; missing Ollama opens the official download page - the app never downloads or runs a binary itself.

nodes.label: Groq Online Transcription
nodes.rationale: Online Fast (whisper-large-v3-turbo) and Online Accurate (whisper-large-v3) validated live with a real key held only in Windows Credential Manager; key never printed/logged; temp clip deleted.

nodes.label: WebView Quiz Feature
nodes.rationale: generate_quiz resolves model from settings via _ollama_settings(); deterministic grounded-cloze fallback shown as Built-in (no AI); correct answer enables Next; session persistence via save_quiz_session -> study.json.

nodes.label: Vulkan Validate (honest backend report)
nodes.rationale: validate_vulkan reports available/selected/loaded/unavailable+reason via EngineRegistry real detection; never silently claims CPU; a CPU-vs-Vulkan wall-time comparison is explicitly NOT claimed without a same-video run.

nodes.label: Job Lifecycle State Machine
nodes.rationale: Authoritative state machine (new/scheduled/queued/running/pause_requested/paused/completed/failed/interrupted/cancelled) with session ownership (session_id/process_id) and reconcile_on_load flipping dead-session running jobs to interrupted; set_lifecycle validates edges.

nodes.label: Job Queue Service
nodes.rationale: One-active invariant, FIFO queue with reorder/Run-Now/remove, atomic persist to queue.json, restart recovery, tz-aware scheduling (zoneinfo + injected clock, tzdata bundled) with missed policies.

nodes.label: WindowsIntegration facade
nodes.rationale: Facade over injectable PowerRequester (keep-awake), TaskbarButton (hand-rolled ctypes ITaskbarList3, no QtWinExtras/comtypes), Notifier (QSystemTrayIcon); no-ops off-Windows.

nodes.label: WebEngine Shipped UI (QWebEngineView)
nodes.rationale: Shipped UI is app/desktop/main.py (QMainWindow + QWebEngineView) loading app/ui (vanilla-JS window.LP + app.css) via bridge.py QWebChannel Backend; the old lecturepack/ui PySide pages are NOT shipped - never build features there.

nodes.label: LECTUREPACK_DATA_DIR override (recommended fix)
nodes.rationale: Recommended: add an env override to paths.py::data_dir() and ConfigManager default so packaged GUI acceptance can run against a throwaway profile instead of the user's real ~/LecturePackData jobs (startup reconciliation would otherwise modify real jobs).

nodes.label: Updater SHA-256 Verification Fix (BUG-32)
nodes.rationale: A catch set expectedSha256=null and the consumer treated null as skip-verification, so the updater could install an unverified installer (shipped in 2.0.0); fixed so verification is never skipped.

nodes.label: AI-First Study Gateway (addendum)
nodes.rationale: After local processing completes, a path-free evidence bundle (transcript text/timestamps, extracted slide text, at most a few accepted slide images) is sent through a first-party HTTPS Study gateway; original video/audio never uploaded; gateway authenticates anonymous installation, selects server-owned provider routes, retains only operational usage metadata. Deterministic Basic fallback remains.

nodes.label: Local-First Privacy Model
nodes.rationale: No telemetry, no video/audio/transcript upload, no university portal access, no modifying the original video; local processing works with LM Studio closed; online modes are explicit and reversible.

nodes.label: Layered Persistence (source/normalized/working/review/study/evidence)
nodes.rationale: Every transformation is attributable and reversible: source layer immutable, normalized regenerable, working editable with undo, review metadata-only, study stored separately, evidence append-only; runtime data lives outside the app package so upgrades preserve user data.

nodes.label: Study Workspace (default landing page)
nodes.rationale: Offline deterministic overview and shortcuts; never calls Ollama or a cloud provider; overview shows provenance label; section headings from Ollama remain marked (AI).

nodes.label: study.json Schema 1
nodes.rationale: Stores bookmarked_slides/bookmarked_sections/last_position atomically; never replaces video, candidates, or transcript layers; old jobs have no migration; missing/corrupt data becomes empty state written only after a user action.

nodes.label: Glassmorphic Dark Theme (Catppuccin Mocha)
nodes.rationale: Catppuccin-Mocha-inspired literal-hex palette (QSS has no variables); theme.py stays single source of truth; dark stays opt-in via Settings (flipping default was outside approved scope until later).

nodes.label: Spatial Study Workspace (bidirectional slides-transcript sync)
nodes.rationale: QSplitter layout; pure bisect-based find_segment_index/find_slide_index helpers; lazy 120-block batching so a 2-hour lecture (~1,400 segments) never pays full widget cost; _programmatic_scroll guard + 50ms debounce prevent feedback loops.

nodes.label: Focus Mode
nodes.rationale: Fades NavRail/CommandBar/StatusBar via one QGraphicsOpacityEffect each (250ms); floating Exit button + Esc/Ctrl+Shift+F exit; animates exactly 3 shell widgets to limit cost.

nodes.label: TranscriptBlockWidget / TranscriptStreamView
nodes.rationale: Lazy 120-block batches, capped live mode; set_live accent-tinted variant for streaming pane; states via dynamic properties + unpolish/polish (zero code for hover).

nodes.label: Studio UI Fidelity Rebuild
nodes.rationale: Pixel-level rebuild to match the LecturePack Studio.dc.html design comp while preserving all business logic, signals and the 38/38 test suite; introduced Space Grotesk/JetBrains Mono load_fonts() and themed QSS.

nodes.label: SVG Navigation Icons
nodes.rationale: Replaced Unicode glyphs with proper SVG icons matching the Studio mockup; _nav_icon replaces currentColor with theme-appropriate hex then converts to QIcon.

nodes.label: Provider-Neutral Transcription Backends
nodes.rationale: Local CPU/Vulkan/Groq adapters behind a provider-neutral interface, so provider-specific branches don't spread through UI/export stack; job records requested vs actual backend incl. fallback reason, model, timing, chunk count, cache status.

nodes.label: Release Governance and Acceptance Gates
nodes.rationale: Checkpointed, scope-limited, evidence-driven: distinguish unit/fake-server tests from live provider tests, and source self-tests from packaged media workflows; a tag/release is not accepted based only on source tests or self-test.

nodes.label: Twelve-Worktree Topology
nodes.rationale: Single biggest source of confusion; the session that shipped 2.0.2 began in the wrong worktree; corrections: main is 8404ddc (has 2.0.0+2.0.1), release-polish already contained all v2.0.1, v2.0.1 is published.

nodes.label: R1: Vulkan instability risk on RX Vega 56
nodes.rationale: Mitigation: CPU fallback primary path always available; diagnostics screen runs a 5-second Vulkan probe before production use; silent default to CPU if probe fails.

nodes.label: FFmpegWrapper.detect_binaries autodetect change
nodes.rationale: beta.2 changed detect_binaries from config_manager.get to autodetect_ffmpeg but a test's MockConfigManager was never updated, causing a stale test double (1 failing test, no user impact); product code always correct; fix mirrors the real fallback contract.
